services.desc: ICA Miami provides a setting and context unlike any other. Now, we have two facilities so that you can host your next event immersed in art. Our 40,000-square-foot facility is a world-class contemporary art museum with a 10,000-square-foot sculpture garden. Centrally located in the Miami Design District, the three-story museum is equipped with parking and security. Most importantly, our museum provides spacious galleries and pristine outdoor conditions, as well as views of Miami's gorgeous tree canopy.
